wargear.name: Blood Chalice
wargear.text: At the start of your Movement Phase, the equipped model or any attached unit may Heal 1 wound. If the unit does not have any models that have suffered Wounds, you may return 1 Slain model to the unit with 1 Wound remaining.

wargear.name: Death Mask
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains the Fear (1) special rule.

wargear.name: Magna Grapple
wargear.text:
Enemy Vehicle, Walker, Automata and Battlesuit units within 3" of a unit equipped with this wargear may not make Retreat moves in the Movement phase.

If a Walker, Automata or Battlesuit unit in combat with this unit would fail a Panic test at the end of the Combat phase, the unit does not move and instead, simply takes 1 automatic wound.

When a unit equipped with this wargear attempts to charge a unit that contains a Vehicle, Automata, Knight, Titan, Walker or Battlesuit type unit, this unit has +1 to its Charge roll.

wargear.name: The Angel's Wing
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model may exchange its Jump Pack for this Relic wargear. The equipped model gains the Move Through Cover special rule and automatically arrives (counts as having rolled a 6) when arriving via Deep Strike. In addition, this wargear counts as a Jump Pack and confers all the benefits of one.

wargear.name: The Crown Angelic
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model with this wargear gains the Fear (3) special rule.

wargear.name: The Veritas Vitae
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model with this wargear generates a Warlord trait from the Blood Angels Warlord Traits. If they are already your Warlord, they may generate an additional Warlord trait.

wargear.name: The Gleaming Pinions
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model may exchange its Jump Pack for this Relic wargear. The equipped model gains the Fade & Fire, Hit & Run and Sprint (1) special rules. In addition, this wargear counts as a Jump Pack and confers all the benefits of one.

wargear.name: Death Mask of Sanguinius
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains the Fear (2) and Sprint (1) special rules.

wargear.name: Halo of Thorns
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains a 3+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Blood Mantle
wargear.text: Friendly Blood Angels units within 12" gain +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

wargear.name: The Quickening
wargear.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker counts as being Initiative (I) 9 until the end start of your next Shooting Phase.

wargear.name: The Red Grail
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear gains a 4+ Invulnerable save. In addition, any attached unit automatically passes Pinning and Panic tests.
